# Parser layout family

The seven originals are unchanged copies from the
[pinned parse directory](https://github.com/bendlang/bend/tree/e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599/tests/parse).
Copyright 2026 HigherOrderCO; Apache-2.0. See NOTICE and licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.

The three `_pure` derivatives replace only their IO main with the unchanged
main.out value (U32 or Nat). They retain the attribution and add no inventory
rows. They qualify normalization independently of the original IO programs.
